medical_stability_status.detail: Meets discharge criteria per morning rounds

medication_education_status.detail: Teach-back completed for discharge medication list

oxygen_requirement.detail: Uses home oxygen 2 L/min at baseline; supply confirmed

patient_education_status.detail: Teaching on inhaler technique and the COPD action plan completed

free_text_notes.physician_note: 74-year-old man with osteoporosis, former smoker (40 pack-years), admitted 3/7 with AECOPD with hypercapnic respiratory failure, now resolved. Weaned from BiPAP on day 2; now on room air at rest. A routine hearing and vision screening was offered to the patient as part of a standard assessment. Both results were within the normal range.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Discharge planning in progress; CM following daily. 3/12 17:00: Team decision tonight: prednisone taper: 30 mg x3 days, then 20 mg x3 days, then stop (was 40 mg daily). Daughter called asking about the plan and does not know about the change; has not been able to reach the physician. Patient worried about the cost of the new medication.
